static_acceptance.card_conf_auto_generated: yes - baseos-init-userdata::ensure_card_config seeds /mnt/SDCARD/baseos.conf on first boot
static_acceptance.card_conf_can_override_release: YES - config_value() order is /mnt/SDCARD > /mnt/boot > /etc; the seeded card file contains usb_debug=yes. This is a blocking risk, see report.
static_acceptance.mtp_only_functionfs: yes - build_gadget() with NETWORK_ENABLED=0 creates only ffs.mtp, clears stale network links and OS descriptors
static_acceptance.dhcp_dropbear_gated: yes - do_start() calls configure_iface/start_dhcp/start_sshd only inside NETWORK_ENABLED=1
static_acceptance.umtp_responder: yes - do_start() calls baseos-usb-mtp start, which mounts functionfs and starts umtprd
static_acceptance.fail_closed: yes - when MTP start fails in MTP-only mode the UDC is left unbound and start exits 1; no network fallback
static_acceptance.config_policy: read-only audit in the temporary boot hook; no existing card baseos.conf is modified

not_executed: Windows PnP enumeration (needs the spare card to be booted)
MTP pull of the 7-file dataset / SHA-256 verification
Mass Storage hand-off (explicitly out of scope)
